last_review.summary: Reviewed all eight acceptance checks against the five deliverables. HTML parsing, JavaScript syntax, and Node checks for seating counts, persistence, purchase restoration, A2 PDF generation, and QR lookup passed in the tested cases. Chromium could not launch in the sandbox, so live browser networking, 390 px layout, touch interactions, visual export fidelity, and phone scanning remain unverified.
issues: CSV import silently drops a record containing only `""`. Preserve explicitly quoted empty records during parsing and report the missing name with its source line number while importing the valid records.
Replace the `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_PAYMENT_LINK` placeholder in `assets/config.js` with a working Stripe Payment Link for the $29 purchase and verify that checkout returns to the app with `?paid=1`.

Remove the extra Fontkit dependency and bundled EB Garamond and Inter fonts. Use system fonts and the PDF library’s built-in fonts as planned. Remove the out-of-scope landing page and sample images from the implementation changeset.
